thread:
michelle: quick q — I'm coming back from parental leave on Jan 3, crossing the company year-end shutdown. I have 3 unused PTO days from this year. Do blackout carryover rules block me from carrying them over? :thinking:

nate-people-ops: hey michelle :wave: good timing. Short answer: we can handle an exception when leave spans the year boundary. We'll need to prorate accruals and confirm with payroll. Did your manager sign off on covering the days?

michelle: yes talked with sarah, she approved the days and coverage. I wanted to check if there's any paperwork or an exceptions form. Also worried about accrual cap — I heard there's a 5 day carry cap?

sarah-manager: confirmed sign-off on my side. I can add the note in the approval thread. We can also swap one of the bridge days if needed. :+1:

nate-people-ops: workflow: 1) we apply a prorated carryover for people returning from leave >30 days that overlap year-end. 2) carryover limited by the accrual cap and blackout policy but exceptions are allowed with manager + People Ops sign-off. 3) payroll needs forms before the Dec 20 cutoff for the year-end payroll window. Please submit here: https://hr.internal/pto-exceptions

michelle: thanks — can you show the prorate calc so I know what to expect?

hr-bot: automated calc snippet for michelle (based on 12 mo annual accrual, 80% FTE):
```
annual_accrual_days = 18
fte = 0.8
months_on_leave = 6
accrued_before_leave = annual_accrual_days * (6/12) * fte = 7.2
unused_current_year = 3
carry_cap = 5
eligible_carry = min(unused_current_year, carry_cap - accrued_before_leave%1)  # policy rounding applied by payroll
result_estimate = 3 (subject to payroll rounding & prorate rules)
```
(Note: this is an estimate — payroll does the final math.)

alex-payroll: @nate-people-ops @michelle I'll need the exception request submitted + manager approval by 2024-12-20 5pm PT to process carryover into Jan payroll. We round to nearest half-day for carry balances and enforce the 5-day cap. If leave spans >180 days we apply special pro-rata rules — not the case here.

nate-people-ops: next steps for michelle: 1) fill the online exception request form (link above) 2) ask sarah to upload her approval note 3) once submitted ppl-ops will sign off and route to payroll. We'll ping you when it's scheduled. :white_check_mark:

michelle: perfect — filing now. thanks everyone! :pray:
